answer: The ink mixer stirs his pigment into the varnish, and the stirring takes an hour of steady work. The anchor is the first stir, made at the bench; the vertex is the last, made when the ink turns black. A cheat must stir 29 false pots and blacken 29 false inks, and the oasis still prints nothing.
